correction_scope: V1 diagonal+Cartesian could starve mixed early-name combinations. For four residual name parameters with at least two names each, V2 reaches all sixteen first-two-name assignments in the first seventeen total bindings including {}. This is a Source-order combinatorial argument, not a runtime test or successful native assignment claim. With more parameters or small cap, shell1 itself can remain unfinished.
errors: Malformed parameter/host/residual/limits raises BindingPrefixDataError(ValueError with code). Callback/native errors propagate unchanged through owned wrapper. Own work/depth becomes bounded prefix reason, never a negative test. No module/producer/native/engine function calls occur inside policy.

inputs.descriptor: Full ordinary receptor-lemma-family-v2 object. Policy checks shape/parameter declarations/references only; family identity/body/registry/native validity must still be freshly checked by fd3e and later independent/native stages.
inputs.host: Full receptor-family-host-v1 object. Only declared variable_names/predicate signature and optional authority.theory.axioms data determine ordering. Other host data retained opaque in request; never authenticate host or inspect target for selection.

limits.rule: Reductions only, exact positive ints; bindings includes empty env.

inputs.residual_parameters: Unique declared IDs, ordinarily from the first fd3e [{}] UNBOUND_UNKNOWN missing_parameters. Untrusted syntax, not a proof receipt. Reordered into descriptor parameter order to avoid caller reordering hints.

integration.additional_prefix: Join initial probe and policy request/current descriptor+host. Consume bindings[1:] only, with remaining attempt cap63 default (or bindingscap-1); do not repeat first probe or exceed shared declared candidate attempt count. If initial probe already grounds, no residual policy is required.
integration.budget: Same cumulative Root native tick and provider own accounting across probe, policy, failed attempts, full expansion and independent/native checks. Never reset native20/512 or per-assignment budget.
integration.first_probe: fd3e infer_observed_ports(candidate_bindings=[{}], limits binding_attempts1/results1). Only UNBOUND_UNKNOWN residual list authorizes this additional proposal-policy path; other errors retain established taxonomy.
integration.unknown: Policy own work/cap may retain complete earlier candidate bindings but cannot claim absent family. All missing/residual/incomplete cases remain advisory UNKNOWN and canonical fallback stays complete.

policy.formula_term: No FORMULA/TERM AST enumeration. Those parameters remain absent from candidate env; fresh fd3e may infer them once formal variable names are bound, or return UNKNOWN. An initial residual FORMULA/TERM must not itself suppress the name trials.
policy.no_semantic_prefilter: Distinct/eigen/capture/current receptor and named-axiom formula membership are not decided by this prefix. Fresh fd3e/full forward/native admission follows. Generic theory-literal AX preflight is a separate provider obligation, not implemented here.
policy.predicates: Lexical declared host predicate symbols with exact matching parameter arity; no origin-symbol preference.
policy.tuples: Residual name parameters in descriptor order. Enumerate maximum-coordinate-index shells from zero. In shell s, lexicographically traverse each domain truncated to indices at most s and emit only tuples whose maximum index equals s. Shells partition the full named product: no duplicated named binding, all first-two-name tuples precede any third-name assignment. Full host domains remain available in later shells; no complete substitution-universe promise.
policy.variables: All VARIABLE roles FREE_PARAMETER/BOUND/EIGEN/EQUALITY_HOLE use the same complete declared host.variable_names domain. Preferred set is lexical literal var/all names found in host.authority.theory.axioms data, filtered to declared names; remaining declared host names lexical. No source-env/descriptor-body/receiver/target names guide priority.

wire.domains: Full parameter_id/kind/role/ordered allowed names for all residual name parameters; optional partial data before syntax validation finishes is never a binding.
wire.entries: One binding_index/channel(EMPTY|MAX_INDEX_SHELL)/domain_indices per retained binding; no phantom binding on incomplete copy.
wire.named_domain_exhausted: null before validated enumeration, false for bounded/incomplete named prefix, true only no named parameters/empty product or complete max-index-shell traversal. Says nothing about formula/term substitutions or native existence.
wire.request: Full copied descriptor/host/residual list; may be null on own copy bound.
wire.status: BINDING_PREFIX if any complete binding objects retained, otherwise UNKNOWN. Either is advisory; prefix is not proof.
